def transform(grid):
    """Recover the horizontally mirrored patch covered by zeros."""
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 0]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in cells)
    width = len(grid[0])
    return [[grid[r][width - 1 - c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
